name: overview-mobile-glass-tabstrip
description: Phone Overview head and tab strip must be glass-backed, and the tab body opaque, in both themes and both glass modes.

allowlist..stack: tabs.module.css is emitted with the tabs- prefix (cssClassPrefixes), so its .stack cannot restyle activitybar.module.css's .stack.

mutation.declaration: shell/activitybar/activitybar.module.css: :global([data-iphone-glass]) .sidebarMobile { background: transparent; } (reverting to the pre-fix transparent sidebar with dead .tablist selector lets the transcript show through the tab strip)
